newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPGS steady to weaker in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPGS steady to weaker in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady to weaker in quiet activity on Thursday amid a recovery in NYMEX futures.
Meanwhile, an international broker said the state-owned oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos has finished loading an 8,000 tonne cargo of propane headed from the U.S. Gulf Coast to Parajitos Port.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held at 33.75/34.00 cents after sinking a half cent Wednesday. 34.00-cent deals were done.
Conway, Kansas, material was slightly down at 35.00/35.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
